028
029public class HandMeDownFreighter extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
030        public static float BASE_PRICE_MULT = 0.4f;
031
032        public static WeightedRandomPicker<String> HULLS = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>();
033        static {
034                HULLS.add("buffalo_Hull", 7f);
035                HULLS.add("tarsus_Hull", 7f);
036                HULLS.add("colossus_Hull", 5f);
037                HULLS.add("atlas_Hull", 1f);
038                HULLS.add("wayfarer_Hull", 5f);
039                HULLS.add("gemini_Hull", 1f);
040                HULLS.add("mule_d_pirates_Hull", 1f);
041                HULLS.add("mule_Hull", 1f);
042        }
043        
044        
045        protected FleetMemberAPI member;
046        protected int price;
047        
048        @Override
049        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
050                
051                float probAbort = 0.75f * PirateBaseManager.getStandardTimeFactor();
052                if (rollProbability(probAbort)) return false;
053                
054                if (barEvent) {
055                        setGiverFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
056                        setGiverPost(Ranks.POST_SPACER);
057                        setGiverVoice(Voices.SPACER);
058                        setGiverImportance(pickLowImportance());
059                        setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD, Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
060                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
061                }
062                
063                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
064                if (person == null) return false;
065                MarketAPI market = person.getMarket();
066                if (market == null) return false;
067                
068                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$hmdf_ref")) {
069                        return false;
070                }
071                
072                if (barEvent) {
073                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
074                }
075                
076                //genRandom = Misc.random;
077                
078//              WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
079//              picker.add("buffalo_Hull", 7f);
080//              picker.add("tarsus_Hull", 7f);
081//              picker.add("colossus_Hull", 5f);
082//              picker.add("atlas_Hull", 1f);
083//              picker.add("wayfarer_Hull", 5f);
084//              picker.add("gemini_Hull", 1f);
085//              picker.add("mule_d_pirates_Hull", 1f);
086//              picker.add("mule_Hull", 1f);
087//              
088//              String variantId = picker.pick();
089                String variantId = HULLS.pick(genRandom);
090                ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId).clone();
091                variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
092                member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variant);
093                assignShipName(member, Factions.INDEPENDENT);
094                
095                boolean worse = Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_worseHandMeDownFreighter");
096                
097                int dMods = 2 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
098                if (worse) dMods = 5;
099                
100                DModManager.addDMods(variant, true, dMods, genRandom);
101                if (!worse) DModManager.removeDMod(variant, HullMods.COMP_STORAGE);
102                
103                member.getCrewComposition().setCrew(100000);
104                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(0.7f);
105                
106                float extMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("ext_shipBuyPriceMult", variant.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal() - 2, 1f) : 1f;
107                if (Misc.isExtended()) extMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_worseHandMeDownFreighterPriceMult");                               
108                price = getRoundNumber(variant.getHullSpec().getBaseValue() * BASE_PRICE_MULT * extMult);
109                
110                setRepFactionChangesTiny();
111                setRepPersonChangesVeryLow();
112                
113                return true;
114        }
115        
116        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
117                // this is weird - in the accept() method, the mission is aborted, which unsets
118                // $hmdf_ref. So: we use $hmdf_ref2 in the ContactPostAccept rule
119                // and $hmdf_ref2 has an expiration of 0, so it'll get unset on its own later.
120                set("$hmdf_ref2", this);
121                
122                set("$hmdf_barEvent", isBarEvent());
123                set("$hmdf_hullClass", member.getHullSpec().getHullNameWithDashClass());
124                set("$hmdf_price", Misc.getWithDGS(price));
125                set("$hmdf_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
126                set("$hmdf_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
127                set("$hmdf_member", member);
128        }
129        
130        @Override
131        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params,
132                                                             Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
133                if ("showShip".equals(action)) {
134                        dialog.getVisualPanel().showFleetMemberInfo(member, true);
135                        return true;
136                } else if ("showPerson".equals(action)) {
137                        dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(getPerson(), true);
138                        return true;
139                }
140                return false;
141        }
142
143        @Override
144        public String getBaseName() {
145                return "Hand-me-down Freighter"; // not used I don't think
146        }
147        
148        @Override
149        public void accept(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
150                // it's just an transaction immediate transaction handled in rules.csv
151                // no intel item etc
152                
153                currentStage = new Object(); // so that the abort() assumes the mission was successful
154                abort();
155                
156                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : getPerson().getMarket().getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
157                        if (fleet.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) continue;
158                        if (!Misc.isPatrol(fleet)) continue;
159                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.PATROL_EXTRA_SUSPICION, 1f);
160                }
161        }
162}
